response: Yes, steroids in aminoglycoside-containing ear drops may help reduce cochlear toxicity. The addition of steroids, such as hydrocortisone, to aminoglycoside ear drops has been shown to decrease the risk of ototoxicity, particularly cochlear toxicity, associated with aminoglycoside use. This is because steroids have anti-inflammatory properties that can help mitigate the damage caused by aminoglycosides to the inner ear. However, more research is needed to fully understand the protective effects of steroids in this context.
